newsitem.title: UK: BADMINTON-ARGENTINA V BRAZIL IN EARLY KICKOFF.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-ARGENTINA V BRAZIL IN EARLY KICKOFF.

text.p: Argentina play Brazil on Monday but don't expect a fired-up crowd of tens of thousands.
The sport is badminton., the start time is 0900 local (0800 GMT) and the venue is Glasgow's leisure centre.
At the same time, Slovakia take on Italy to be followed by Lithuania v Turkmenistan and Luxembourg v Malta.
The games, the first of 122 matches in all, are the opening salvo in the Sudirman Cup world mixed team tournament with holders China seeking to retain the title they won two years ago in Switzerland.
After the withdrawal of Nigeria and Morocco, 61 nations are left to do battle, with China and Indonesia strong favourites to fight out Saturday's final.
The weaker nations are split into divisions with the winners gaining promotion to a higher rank for the next Cup in two years' time.
The action starts in earnest on Tuesday night when England meet China and Indonesia play Sweden.

China have world number ones in three categories -- Dong Jiong in the men's singles, Ye Zhaoying in the women's singles and Olympic women's doubles champions Ge Fei and Gu Jun. Indonesia look to the men's world champion Heryanto Arbi and the vastly experienced Susi Susanti.
After the Sudirman Cup players contest the world individual championships which end on June 1.
